name: Kasumi-chan Ryoujoku ~Jigokuhen~
source:
A certain western manor...
Where an anachronistic society catered to elite clients...
A world exclusive to VIPs, sick twists who wore the masks as in public...
but here... drunken and private, in a place of fantasy...

"My name is Kasumi. Come this way..."

An incredible ninja. A deadly woman... completely at their mercy.

Dead or Alive's Kasumi as a gangbanged sex slave. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE127205.html]DLsite English[/url]]
